test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Optional
solution: ​The correct answer is '**Compulsory**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Optional**' is '**Compulsory**'. • **Optional**: that you can choose or not choose. [वैकल्पिक(जिसे आप चुन या छोड़ सकते हैं)] • *Example: an **optional** subject at school...* • **Compulsory**: that must be done, by law, rules, etc. [(क़ानून-नियम आदि से) अनिवार्य; बाध्यकर] • *Example: Maths and English are **compulsory** subjects on this course.* **Correct Answer:__** *Compulsory.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Voluntary**: done or given because you want to do it, not because you have to do it. [अपनी इच्‍छा से (न कि विवशता से) किया या दिया गया; स्‍वैच्‍छिक] • **Arbitrary**: not seeming to be based on any reason or plan and sometimes seeming unfair. (बिना तर्क, नियम या योजना पर आधारित और कभी-कभी अनुचित; मनमाना, स्‍वेच्‍छाचारी) • **Elective**: using or chosen by-election. (निर्वाचन करने वाला या निर्वाचित) 1c0:T817, The correct answer is** 'about taking up'.**
